XMLDB.COMMENT: Sentientia LMS GenAI Authoring Studio — P0.3 (MVP) schema. Five tables: template (instructional-design templates), draft (one course-generation request), card (interactive lesson cards within a draft), question (MCQ/MRQ/match items with AI feedback), voiceover (TTS jobs, mock by default). Every table carries customerid + costcenterid + timecreated + timemodified per the multi-tenant scope convention.

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_auth_template
TABLE.COMMENT: P0.3 (2026-06-16) — Editable instructional-design templates. A template defines the structure + tone the course generator should follow (e.g. 'Compliance micro-module: hook → 3 concept cards → scenario → 5-Q quiz'). Trainers CRUD these; the generator references one by id at generation time. `is_builtin` marks the seeded starter templates that ship with the plugin (editable but not deletable). `body` is the template prompt scaffold sent to Claude; `structure_json` is an optional machine-readable outline (card count, question mix). Tenant-scoped via customerid + costcenterid.

FIELD.NAME: ownerid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to user.id — author of the template. 0 = system/built-in.

FIELD.NAME: customerid
FIELD.COMMENT: Sentientia LMS customer scope. Phase 1: hardcoded 1 (Airpay).

FIELD.NAME: costcenterid
FIELD.COMMENT: BizLMS tenant root (1=Airpay, 77=Public, 177=ZEEA). 0 = shared/built-in.

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Display name shown in the template picker.

FIELD.NAME: description
FIELD.COMMENT: Trainer-facing description of when to use this template.

FIELD.NAME: body
FIELD.COMMENT: The instructional-design prompt scaffold injected into the system prompt at generation time.

FIELD.NAME: structure_json
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional JSON outline: {num_cards, question_mix:{multichoice,mrq,match}, mastery_score}.

FIELD.NAME: is_builtin
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = ships with the plugin (editable, not deletable). 0 = trainer-created.

FIELD.NAME: archived
FIELD.COMMENT: Soft-delete flag. 1 = hidden from the picker but kept for audit.

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_auth_draft
TABLE.COMMENT:
P0.3 (2026-06-16) — One row per course-generation request. Lifecycle: pending (created, AI call in flight) → generated (Claude/mock returned, cards+questions persisted, awaiting review) → approved (reviewer approved ≥1 card) → published (course built / handed to SOP→SCORM packager) → rejected (reviewer dismissed) → failed (API error).
`sourcetext` carries the verbatim prompt / Doc text / PDF extract sent to Claude. `sourcetype` records whether it came from a free prompt, a pasted Doc, or PDF-extracted text. `templateid` (nullable) ties the draft to the instructional-design template used. `targetlang` records the requested output language; localized output is routed through local_sentientia_translate when present.
customerid + costcenterid follow the standard multi-tenant scope convention; prompt_version supports A/B prompt testing without losing the audit trail.

FIELD.NAME: ownerid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to user.id — Course Author who created the draft.

FIELD.NAME: customerid
FIELD.COMMENT: Sentientia LMS customer scope. Phase 1: hardcoded 1 (Airpay).

FIELD.NAME: costcenterid
FIELD.COMMENT: BizLMS tenant root (1=Airpay, 77=Public, 177=ZEEA). Derived from creator open_path at draft time.

FIELD.NAME: templateid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to local_sentientia_auth_template.id. NULL = freeform (no template).

FIELD.NAME: title
FIELD.COMMENT: Trainer-supplied course title for the review queue list.

FIELD.NAME: sourcetype
FIELD.COMMENT: prompt | doc | pdf — provenance of sourcetext.

FIELD.NAME: sourcetext
FIELD.COMMENT: Verbatim prompt / Doc text / PDF extract sent to Claude. PII screening is the trainer's responsibility (UI warns at paste time).

FIELD.NAME: targetlang
FIELD.COMMENT: Requested output language code (en, hi, ...). Localized output routed via local_sentientia_translate when present.

FIELD.NAME: model
FIELD.COMMENT: Anthropic model identifier used for the generation. Recorded for audit.

FIELD.NAME: prompt_version
FIELD.COMMENT: System-prompt revision tag. Allows safe A/B prompt-quality testing.

FIELD.NAME: mastery_score
FIELD.COMMENT: Mastery / pass threshold for the generated assessment (CLAUDE.md §8 default 70; configurable per customer).

FIELD.NAME: num_cards
FIELD.COMMENT: How many interactive cards Claude returned (parser-validated).

FIELD.NAME: num_questions
FIELD.COMMENT: How many questions Claude returned (parser-validated).

FIELD.NAME: tokens_in
FIELD.COMMENT: Anthropic input_tokens reported by API for cost tracking.

FIELD.NAME: tokens_out
FIELD.COMMENT: Anthropic output_tokens reported by API for cost tracking.

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: pending | generated | approved | published | rejected | failed

FIELD.NAME: error_detail
FIELD.COMMENT: On status=failed: short error tag + HTTP code. NEVER include API key text.

FIELD.NAME: reviewed_by
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to user.id of the reviewer who finalised the review (NULL until reviewed).

FIELD.NAME: reviewed_at
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix timestamp when review completed.

FIELD.NAME: published_courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to course.id once status=published. NULL until then.

FIELD.NAME: generated_at
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix timestamp of generation completion (or attempt timestamp on failure).

INDEX.NAME: idx_owner_status
INDEX.COMMENT: Trainer review queue: 'my drafts awaiting review'

INDEX.NAME: idx_customer_tenant
INDEX.COMMENT: Per-customer / per-tenant cost analytics + tenant scoping

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_auth_card
TABLE.COMMENT: P0.3 (2026-06-16) — One row per interactive lesson card within a draft. Cascade-delete with parent draft. A card is a micro-unit of content (concept, example, scenario, flip card). `cardtype` drives the front-end rendering; `body` is the card content; `flip_back` holds the reverse face for flip cards. `status` lifecycle: generated → approved | edited | rejected. Only approved/edited cards are published.

FIELD.NAME: draftid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to local_sentientia_auth_draft.id

FIELD.NAME: cardtype
FIELD.COMMENT: concept | example | scenario | flip — front-end render hint.

FIELD.NAME: heading
FIELD.COMMENT: Card heading / title.

FIELD.NAME: body
FIELD.COMMENT: Card body content (front face for flip cards).

FIELD.NAME: flip_back
FIELD.COMMENT: Reverse face content for cardtype=flip. NULL otherwise.

FIELD.NAME: narration
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional narration script for this card — the source text a TTS voiceover job reads.

FIELD.NAME: sortorder
FIELD.COMMENT: Display order within the draft (1, 2, 3, ...). Lower = first.

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: generated | approved | edited | rejected

FIELD.NAME: reviewer_note
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional reviewer comment. Visible in audit history.

INDEX.NAME: idx_draft_sort
INDEX.COMMENT: Render cards in display order for a draft

INDEX.NAME: idx_status
INDEX.COMMENT: Publish query: select where status IN ('approved','edited')

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_auth_question
TABLE.COMMENT:
P0.3 (2026-06-16) — One row per generated question. Cascade-delete with parent draft. Expands beyond MCQ:
qtype = 'multichoice' — 4 options, exactly ONE correct. qtype = 'mrq' — multi-response: N options, 1+ correct (qanswer is a JSON array of correct indices). qtype = 'match' — match-the-following: qoptions_json holds the left-hand stems, qanswer holds the JSON map of left-index → right-value pairs.
`qoptions_json` semantics depend on qtype: multichoice/mrq → JSON array of option strings match → JSON array of {left, right} pairs `qanswer` semantics depend on qtype: multichoice → '0'..'3' (single index) mrq → JSON array of correct indices e.g. '[0,2]' match → JSON map of correct pairings
`qfeedback_correct` / `qfeedback_incorrect` carry the AI contextual feedback shown to the learner. `points` weights the question toward the mastery score. `status` lifecycle: generated → approved | edited | rejected.

FIELD.NAME: draftid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to local_sentientia_auth_draft.id

FIELD.NAME: qtype
FIELD.COMMENT: multichoice | mrq | match

FIELD.NAME: qtext
FIELD.COMMENT: Question stem as produced by Claude (or edited by reviewer).

FIELD.NAME: qoptions_json
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON. multichoice/mrq: array of option strings. match: array of {left,right} pairs.

FIELD.NAME: qanswer
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON/string. multichoice: '0'..'3'. mrq: JSON array of indices. match: JSON map of pairings.

FIELD.NAME: qfeedback_correct
FIELD.COMMENT: AI contextual feedback shown when the learner answers correctly.

FIELD.NAME: qfeedback_incorrect
FIELD.COMMENT: AI contextual feedback shown when the learner answers incorrectly.

FIELD.NAME: qexplanation
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional rationale explaining the correct answer. Shown in the review UI.

FIELD.NAME: points
FIELD.COMMENT: Weight of this question toward the mastery score. Default 1.

FIELD.NAME: sortorder
FIELD.COMMENT: Display order within the draft (1, 2, 3, ...). Lower = first.

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: generated | approved | edited | rejected

FIELD.NAME: reviewer_note
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional reviewer comment. Visible in audit history.

INDEX.NAME: idx_draft_sort
INDEX.COMMENT: Render questions in display order for a draft

INDEX.NAME: idx_status
INDEX.COMMENT: Publish query: select where status IN ('approved','edited')

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_auth_voiceover
TABLE.COMMENT: P0.3 (2026-06-16) — One row per TTS voiceover job for a card's narration. MOCK by default (no live ElevenLabs spend): when sentientia.authoring.live_api is OFF, the tts_client writes a deterministic placeholder marker into audio_ref and records mode='mock'. When live, audio_ref points at the stored mp3 file (Moodle file API) and mode is 'live'. `status` lifecycle: pending → ready | failed. Audio is review-gated like every other generated artefact — a voiceover is not 'published' until the parent draft is.

FIELD.NAME: draftid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to local_sentientia_auth_draft.id

FIELD.NAME: cardid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to local_sentientia_auth_card.id — the card whose narration is voiced.

FIELD.NAME: customerid
FIELD.COMMENT: Sentientia LMS customer scope.

FIELD.NAME: costcenterid
FIELD.COMMENT: BizLMS tenant root. Derived from requester open_path.

FIELD.NAME: voice_id
FIELD.COMMENT: TTS voice identifier. 'mock' for mock-mode jobs; ElevenLabs voice id when live.

FIELD.NAME: lang
FIELD.COMMENT: Language code of the narration text voiced.

FIELD.NAME: charcount
FIELD.COMMENT: Character count of the narration — drives cost estimate + soft cap.

FIELD.NAME: audio_ref
FIELD.COMMENT: Reference to the generated audio: mock marker (mock mode) or stored file path (live).

FIELD.NAME: mode
FIELD.COMMENT: mock | live — which path produced this job.

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: pending | ready | failed

FIELD.NAME: error_detail
FIELD.COMMENT: On status=failed: short error tag. NEVER include API key text.

INDEX.NAME: idx_draft_status
INDEX.COMMENT: Voiceover jobs for a draft, by status
